instruction: Could you use GIMP's internal tools to download the University of Toronto logo as a PNG file from their official website, avoiding any external web browser?

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP does not provide web browsing or file download functionality. It cannot access remote URLs or download content from the internet on its own.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - GIMP does not have built-in web browsing or HTTP download capabilities
